evals.prompt: I have a 3-factor questionnaire and want to run a confirmatory factor analysis and report whether it fits.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-sem-psychometrics: specifies the CFA in semopy (=~ syntax), fits it, reports CFI/TLI/RMSEA against Hu & Bentler cutoffs, and reports reliability with omega computed from the standardized loadings (not alpha alone).

assertions.value: Fits a CFA in semopy and reports fit indices against cutoffs plus omega reliability.

evals.prompt: Fit a structural equation model where trust predicts satisfaction and satisfaction predicts loyalty, all latent.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-sem-psychometrics: writes the measurement (=~) and structural (~) parts in semopy, fits, and reports standardized path coefficients with model fit.

assertions.value: Builds a latent-variable SEM with measurement and structural parts and reports fit + standardized paths.

evals.prompt: Before I compare latent trust means across three countries, how do I test measurement invariance?
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-sem-psychometrics: prescribes a multi-group CFA sequence configural -> metric -> scalar (-> strict), judged by ΔCFI/ΔRMSEA, and notes that scalar invariance is required before comparing latent means.

evals.prompt: Fit an item response theory model to my dichotomous test items and give me item difficulty and discrimination.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-sem-psychometrics: uses a 2PL/Rasch IRT fit (girth twopl_mml / rasch_mml), returns discrimination and difficulty, and notes R mirt for polytomous/multidimensional needs.

assertions.value: Fits an IRT model and reports item discrimination/difficulty, flagging R mirt for models beyond 2PL.

evals.prompt: Should I even trust this scale? Is reliability the same as validity here?
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger this skill; defers to alterlab-ssci-measurement-gate. Whether to trust the scale (reliability vs validity discipline) is the gate decision, upstream of fitting a factor model.

evals.prompt: Run a plain multiple regression of income on age and education and give me the coefficients.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger this skill; defers to alterlab-statistical-analysis. There is no latent-variable / measurement model — it is observed-variable regression.
